policy: Proof-bar ruling 1: words where native MPAS-A itself reads undefined memory are excluded only with a full witness (measured run-to-run variation of the pinned strict binary, plus a bounds-checked build naming the read) and the owner's sign-off for that specific case. Averaged, RMS or relative-error grades never count as landing proof. Ruling 2: every proof fixes the process count and states it. An entry covers exactly one unit, one case, one field and one word set; tools/native_undefined_exclusions.py refuses everything else, and every word outside the set is still compared with no tolerance.
paths: Witness and sign-off paths are relative to the repository root (the folder that holds tree/). They are home evidence and are not part of the public tree.

entries.label: DECLARED RESIDUE (native reads undefined memory); never called identical

native.mechanism: A cell whose latitude equals the final ozone-table latitude exactly passes neither endpoint test at 157-162, so the search loop at 164-166 reaches i=64 and reads lat_ozone(65), one past the 64-entry table. Whether it exits there depends on that undefined value, so i1/i2 become 64/65 or 65/66, and lines 171-184 build every month and level of that cell's ozmixm from latitude entries past the end of the table.

entries.trigger: Reached only by the synthetic witness fixture: the first global cell's latitude is patched to exactly the final OZONE_LAT.TBL latitude. No selected real case reaches it, and the real-case replays compare every word with no exclusion.

witness.native_binary: pinned strict native MPAS-A v8.4.2 atmosphere_model, unchanged
witness.mesh: x1.2562, 2023-03-31 12Z initial state, zero run duration, radiation initialization on
witness.observation: Every varying word is month 12 (C index 11 mod 12). Repeats at one process are stable on each host, but the two hosts disagree on 27 words; at two processes the words differ from one process on both hosts, and in the supplementary second-host session the two-process repeats also differ from each other. Words outside the set are identical across every run, host and process count (full-field masked reconstruction in the policy receipts).
